cycle.label: Renewal period
cycle.note: Licenses renew every two years on June 30. All 80 hours can be done in either year; no carryover.

requirements.label: Professional ethics
requirements.note: 4 hours of professional ethics each renewal (252 CMR 2.14). Massachusetts doesn't require a state-specific course.

newLicensee.note: First renewal prorated by the month your license was issued: July–Sept 80, Oct–Dec 70, Jan–Mar 60, Apr–June 50. The 4 ethics hours still apply.

licenseDateHint: Massachusetts licenses expire June 30, every two years.
issueDateHint: If your license was issued during this renewal period, your first renewal is prorated by the month it was issued.
limitsNotTracked: Instruction: no more than 50% of the requirement (40 of 80 hours) (NASBA summary of Massachusetts rules).
Published articles and books: no more than 20 hours (25% of 80).
University courses: 15 CPE per semester hour (credit set by the course).
recordRetention: Keep certificates and course details; you sign a statement under penalty of perjury at renewal and the Board can ask for proof.
toVerify: Both Regulatory and Behavioral Ethics count toward the 4 ethics hours (the rule says 'professional ethics').
First renewal: inferred when the issue date falls inside the current renewal period; hours by issue month per the Board FAQ.
The 4 ethics hours are kept in a prorated first renewal as a cautious default: 252 CMR 2.14 and the Board FAQ don't say whether ethics is prorated.
